Meanwhile, Kimi25 Analyst has board wipe potential with the kicked version (costs {2}{R}{R}{W}{W} = 6 mana) which would destroy all other creatures including GLM47 Sarge's Plaguecrafter and Prosperous Innkeeper. With only 4 untapped lands available, the kick isn't possible this turn, but deploying it without kicker wastes the powerful board wipe effect permanently. Faith's Fetters on Maskwood Nexus or Plaguecrafter would have been more impactful, neutralizing a key permanent while gaining 4 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Desolation Giant without kicker, getting a 3/3 body that destroys nothing (no other creatures controlled).
annotations.betterLine: Cast Faith's Fetters on a threatening permanent like GLM47 Sarge's Maskwood Nexus or Plaguecrafter, gaining 4 life and neutralizing a real threat. Save Desolation Giant for when you can kick it to wipe opponents' boards, or at least when opponents have more creatures to punish.

annotations.description: Haiku Vorthos passed without playing a land from hand despite having Island and Plains available. Missing a land drop is free value lost, and an extra Plains would power up Armored Ascension later. With 4 cards in hand and no creatures yet, hitting land drops is critical to eventually deploying threats with equipment/auras.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed the turn without playing a land, despite having Island and Plains in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains from hand to increase Plains count (powering up future Armored Ascension) and ensure no missed land drops.

annotations.description: Squirrel Nest provides slow incremental value (one 1/1 per turn) while The Odd Acorn Gang would be an immediate 5/5 with menace, trample, and reach that synergizes powerfully with Maskwood Nexus (all creatures are Squirrels, so they can all use the pump ability). The Odd Acorn Gang also draws cards when Squirrels deal combat damage, providing much faster board impact.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Squirrel Nest (1GG) to slowly generate 1/1 squirrel tokens
annotations.betterLine: Cast The Odd Acorn Gang (3BG) for an immediate 5/5 threat with menace/trample/reach that synergizes with Maskwood Nexus making all creatures Squirrels, enabling pump abilities and card draw on combat damage

annotations.description: Enchanting Temple of Malady with Squirrel Nest removes a dual-colored mana source (B/G) from mana production. Since Squirrel Nest replaces the land's abilities with just token production, GLM47 Sarge loses access to a colored mana source. Exotic Orchard would be a better target since it only produces mana based on opponents' lands and is less critical, or even better, putting it on a basic Swamp would preserve the dual-land's flexibility. With cards like End-Raze Forerunners (5GGG) and The Odd Acorn Gang (3BG) in hand requiring significant colored mana, losing a BG dual land hurts casting ability.
annotations.actionTaken: Enchanted Temple of Malady with Squirrel Nest, removing a BG dual land from mana production.
annotations.betterLine: Enchant Exotic Orchard or the basic Swamp with Squirrel Nest to preserve more valuable colored mana sources, especially with expensive colored spells in hand.

annotations.description: Casting Hunted Dragon gives an opponent three 2/2 Knight tokens with first strike. In a multiplayer game where Kimi25 has no board presence besides equipment and lands, giving free creatures to an opponent is a significant downside. Additionally, playing Ancient Amphitheater first (revealing Hunted Dragon as a Giant) would let it enter untapped, providing an extra land. More importantly, Warstorm Surge at 6 mana could be cast next turn and would provide much more lasting value, turning every future creature into removal. Faith's Fetters on the Neverwinter Hydra (which is likely a significant threat from Gem25F at 19hp) would neutralize a threat and gain 4 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Hunted Dragon, giving an opponent three 2/2 first strike Knight tokens
annotations.betterLine: Play Ancient Amphitheater (revealing Hunted Dragon so it enters untapped), then consider casting Faith's Fetters on Neverwinter Hydra to neutralize the biggest threat while gaining 4 life, saving Hunted Dragon for after Warstorm Surge is online to deal 6 damage on entry.

annotations.description: Hunted Dragon's ETB gives an opponent three 2/2 white Knight tokens with first strike. Giving these to GLM47 Sarge (44 life, highest life total) is one of the worse choices. Gem25F Stoic is at 19 life and is the biggest threat on the board with Neverwinter Hydra — giving them three 2/2s is bad. But Haiku Vorthos has a relatively empty board with no creatures and would benefit least from three 2/2 first strikers since they lack synergies. More importantly, GLM47 Sarge has Prosperous Innkeeper which triggers 'whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life' — and with Maskwood Nexus making all creatures all types, the three Knight tokens entering will each trigger Prosperous Innkeeper, gaining Sarge 3 life. Giving tokens to the player who gains life from creature ETBs is clearly suboptimal.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose GLM47 Sarge as the target for Hunted Dragon's ETB, giving them three 2/2 Knight tokens with first strike.
annotations.betterLine: Choose Haiku Vorthos, who has the least ability to leverage three 2/2 tokens and doesn't have ETB synergies like Prosperous Innkeeper. Alternatively, even giving them to Gem25F Stoic (already the biggest threat but at lowest life) would avoid feeding Sarge's life gain engine.

annotations.description: Gem25F Stoic cast Rishkar's Expertise without first playing Path of Ancestry from hand. Path of Ancestry enters tapped so it doesn't affect mana this turn, but playing it first ensures the land drop isn't wasted. After drawing 9 cards, they won't be able to make a land drop since it's already been used (or in this case, missed entirely).
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Rishkar's Expertise without playing Path of Ancestry first
annotations.betterLine: Play Path of Ancestry (enters tapped), then cast Rishkar's Expertise using Sol Ring + Haven + Forest + Mountain. This ensures the land drop isn't wasted while still casting the same spell.

annotations.description: Rishkar's Expertise was available (shown as 'Unknown' in choices, and visible in hand) but was incorrectly dismissed as 'no longer available.' With Neverwinter Hydra on board (likely with significant +1/+1 counters from d6 rolls), Rishkar's Expertise would draw multiple cards AND allow casting a free spell with MV 5 or less (like Dragon's Hoard or Bag of Tricks). This is substantially more impactful than just casting a single 5/5 flyer.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Hoard-Smelter Dragon for 6 mana, deploying a single 5/5 threat
annotations.betterLine: Cast Rishkar's Expertise to draw cards equal to Neverwinter Hydra's power, then cast Dragon's Hoard or Bag of Tricks for free, generating massive card advantage and board development in one turn

annotations.description: Playing Island instead of Plains when holding Armored Ascension, which gives +1/+1 for each Plains controlled. With no creatures on board currently, maximizing Plains count for when Armored Ascension can eventually be cast would provide more value.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Island from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains instead to maximize the eventual Armored Ascension buff (+1/+1 per Plains). The Island could be played on a future turn instead.

annotations.description: With all lands and mana sources tapped, GLM47 Sarge likely cannot cast Bastion of Remembrance (costs {2}{B}). Even if the game engine somehow allows the cast, they should prioritize the land drop first to have mana available.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose Bastion of Remembrance with apparently no untapped mana sources
annotations.betterLine: Play Temple of Malady as a land drop first. If no mana is available to cast spells, pass the turn after making the land drop.

annotations.description: Player believes Hunted Dragon is already on the battlefield ready to attack, but it's actually still in hand (the Unknown card in choices). They passed without casting anything, missing the opportunity to cast Fellwar Stone (2 mana) then Hunted Dragon (using remaining 3 mana + Fellwar Stone for 5 total). Even though 6 damage doesn't kill Gem25F at 9 life, deploying the threat with haste via Lightning Greaves applies significant pressure. Additionally, at minimum Fellwar Stone should have been cast for mana development.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting anything, believing they already had Hunted Dragon on the battlefield ready to attack.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Fellwar Stone (2 mana from untapped lands), then cast Hunted Dragon using remaining 2 untapped lands + Fellwar Stone (5 mana total for {3}{R}{R}), equip Lightning Greaves for free, and attack Gem25F Stoic for 6 damage, bringing them to 3 life.

annotations.description: Gem25F Stoic is at 3 life. Kimi25 Analyst has Meteor Blast in hand, which costs X{R}{R}{R}. With the available untapped lands (2 Plains, 1 Mountain, 1 Mountain) plus Lightning Greaves and Seer's Sundial (non-mana), let me recount: Looking at the battlefield, the tapped lands are 2 Mountains and 1 Plains. Untapped lands are: 2 Plains, 2 Mountains. Plus Fellwar Stone could be cast, but that doesn't help this turn. Meteor Blast for X=1 costs {1}{R}{R}{R} = 4 mana, dealing 4 damage to 1 target. With 2 untapped Plains and 2 untapped Mountains, that's exactly 4 mana (1 generic from Plains + RRR from remaining Plains+2Mountains... wait, Plains don't produce R). Let me recount: Untapped permanents: 2 Plains (W each), 2 Mountains (R each), Seer's Sundial, Lightning Greaves. For Meteor Blast X=1: need RRRR total? No - it's X{R}{R}{R}, so X=1 costs 1+RRR = 4 mana. The 1 generic can come from a Plains, and RRR needs 3 red sources. Only 2 Mountains are untapped, so only 2R available. Can't cast Meteor Blast for X=1. But wait - Fellwar Stone costs {2} and could be cast with the 2 Plains, but it enters tapped... no, Fellwar Stone doesn't enter tapped. Cast Fellwar Stone with 2 Plains, then tap 2 Mountains + Fellwar Stone for RRR+1 colored mana = enough for Meteor Blast X=1 dealing 4 damage to Gem25F Stoic at 3 life, killing them. This is missing lethal on a player at 3 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells, allowing Gem25F Stoic to survive at 3 life with a Neverwinter Hydra on board.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Fellwar Stone (2 mana from Plains), then cast Meteor Blast for X=1 (2 Mountains + Fellwar Stone for RRR + generic) targeting Gem25F Stoic to deal 4 damage, killing them at 3 life.
